answer: Social Matters >> Rights & Etiquettes Question ID: 973 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: What is the way to bring my wife on DEEN? Also she is very much non obedient and rude, what should I do? PLEASE GUIDE ME Question: What is the way to bring my wife on DEEN? Also she is very much non obedient and rude, what should I do? PLEASE GUIDE ME Answer ID: 973 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 740=693/B) Treat her politely with good morals and try to fulfil her rightful demands and be kind to her; in-sha-Allah she will stay obliged and obedient to you. Then try to convey her religious information; in-sha-Allah she shall gradually get on right path and obey you. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
